messages:
Leo: Taking the evening oncall — I'm on until 02:00 PT. Quick summary:
- What I did: reacted to a regen queue spike (~3x) between 16:20-16:45, scaled an extra pool and bumped autoscaler min to 4. Rolled back the canary routing rule that was forcing small-quant models for regen; seemed to help.
- Current: p95 regen latency ~420ms (baseline ~280ms). No 5xx customer errors. Embed ingest throughput still high but within limits.
- Blockers: high prefix cache miss rate — looks correlated with an index rebuild job that started around 16:10. I don't have an immediate causal root yet.

Anya: thanks — can you paste the exact commands you ran to scale/rollback so I can bookmark for the runbook?

Leo: sure:```bash
kubectl scale deployment/regen-worker --replicas=6 -n prod
kubectl patch deploy routing-controller -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"routing/canary":"off"}}}}}' -n prod
# confirm pods
kubectl get pods -l app=regen-worker -n prod
```

Sarah: fyi I kicked off the index rebuild for the new vector shard at 16:05 to prewarm lookups. I paused ingest at 16:50 after seeing the regen lag spike. Pause ID: rebuild-vec-2026-03-17.

DeployBot: Canary deploy "routing-policy-v2" completed at 17:45 :white_check_mark: (no errors). Metric diff: +5% tail latency for small models, flagged by perf-alert.

Michael: I'll watch autoscaler churn overnight and temporarily suppress the marginal scale-notice alert for the pool you changed. Added a note in paging config to not wake on single-instance upscales.

Leo: Next steps I'm leaving in the runbook: monitor p95 regen. If p95 > 500ms for >5m, trigger regional fallback (route regen->us-east secondary). Command to trigger:```bash
curl -X POST https://control-plane.internal/route-fallback -d '{"service":"regen","target":"us-east","reason":"p95>500"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ONCALL_TOKEN"
```
I'll also follow up with infra tomorrow to walk through the index rebuild timing and see if we can stage it outside peak hours.

Anya: noted. I've assigned a follow-up ticket (#ENG-4821) to dig into prefix cache eviction patterns. Will check dashboards at 00:30 PT. :eyes: 

Sarah: re-open if I should resume ingest — currently paused until we confirm miss-rate recovery.

Leo: thanks all — handoff complete. I'll post another short status update if anything changes. :thumbsup:
